rows.label: heavy metal music
rows.description: genre of rock music characterized by slack-tuned instruments, and unconventional changes of tonality (key) and time signature (metre)
rows.hook: is defined by thunderous distorted guitars, pounding drums and dark, powerful vocals

rows.label: shoegaze
rows.description: indie/alternative rock subgenre characterized by an ethereal mixture of obscured vocals, guitar distortion and effects, feedback, and overwhelming volume
rows.hook: is a dreamy wall of blurred guitar noise where the singing is buried in the haze

rows.label: country music
rows.description: genre of American popular music
rows.hook: grew out of Nashville, with twangy guitars and songs about trucks, heartbreak and small-town life

rows.label: hip-hop
rows.description: rhythmic music accompanied by rhyming speech
rows.hook: grew out of block parties in the Bronx, built on DJs, breakbeats and rapped rhymes

rows.label: jazz
rows.description: musical style and genre
rows.hook: was born in New Orleans and is known for improvisation, swing and syncopated rhythm

rows.label: nu metal
rows.description: musical subgenre of alternative metal
rows.hook: fuses heavy guitar riffs with rapping and turntables, led by bands like Korn and Limp Bizkit

rows.label: grunge
rows.description: genre of rock music
rows.hook: came out of Seattle with flannel shirts, angst-filled lyrics and bands like Nirvana and Pearl Jam

rows.label: K-pop
rows.description: popular music originating in South Korea
rows.hook: is a polished export of idol groups with tightly choreographed dances and colorful videos

rows.label: progressive rock
rows.description: genre of rock music
rows.hook: is known for long, ambitious songs, concept albums and classical influences, as with Yes and Genesis

rows.label: post-punk
rows.description: music genre
rows.hook: followed the first safety-pin wave with moodier, more experimental sounds, as with Joy Division

rows.label: rock and roll
rows.description: genre of popular music, early subgenre of rock music
rows.hook: turned Elvis Presley and Chuck Berry into stars, mixing country twang with rhythm and blues

rows.label: blues
rows.description: vocal and instrumental music form
rows.hook: grew from the Mississippi Delta, with twelve-bar songs of hardship and a bent-note guitar sound

rows.label: house music
rows.description: electronic dance music genre, that originated in Chicago, United States, in the early 1980s
rows.hook: grew out of Chicago clubs, driven by a steady four-on-the-floor kick drum

rows.label: bluegrass music
rows.description: form of American roots music
rows.hook: is famous for lightning-fast banjo picking and high harmonies from acoustic string bands

rows.label: contemporary R&B
rows.description: popular music genre that combines rhythm and blues with elements of pop, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic music
rows.hook: blends smooth soul vocals with modern beats, as with Beyonce and Usher

rows.label: funk
rows.description: music genre that emerged in the 1960s, blending soul, jazz, and R&B, known for its syncopated basslines, groovy rhythms, and danceable energy
rows.hook: is built on a heavy, syncopated bass groove, made famous by James Brown and Parliament

rows.label: trip hop
rows.description: genre of electronic music
rows.hook: is a slow, moody, sample-heavy sound from Bristol, made famous by Massive Attack and Portishead

rows.label: bossa nova
rows.description: style of Brazilian music
rows.hook: is a smooth, gentle rhythm behind The Girl from Ipanema

rows.label: Britpop
rows.description: music genre; 1990s UK pop culture movement
rows.hook: was a mid-1990s wave of guitar bands, with a famous chart rivalry between Blur and Oasis

rows.label: flamenco
rows.description: genre of Spanish music and dance
rows.hook: pairs passionate singing and fast guitar strumming with stamping dance and clapping in Andalusia

rows.label: reggae
rows.description: music genre that originated in Jamaica in the late 1960s
rows.hook: is known for its offbeat, laid-back rhythm and was carried worldwide by Bob Marley

rows.label: soul
rows.description: genre of popular music
rows.hook: is gospel-rooted, emotional singing, made famous by Aretha Franklin and Otis Redding

rows.label: glam rock
rows.description: style of rock music that developed in the United Kingdom in the early 1970s performed by musicians who wore outrageous costumes, makeup, and hairstyles, particularly platform shoes and glitter
rows.hook: is known for glitter, platform boots and flamboyant stars like David Bowie and T. Rex

rows.label: Krautrock
rows.description: genre of music that originated in Germany in the late 1960s
rows.hook: is an experimental style of motorik beats and synthesizers, with bands like Can and Kraftwerk nearby

rows.label: rockabilly
rows.description: early style of rock and roll music
rows.hook: mixes hillbilly twang with early rhythm and blues, with slap bass and greased-up quiffs

rows.label: calypso
rows.description: style of Afro-Caribbean music that originated in Trinidad and Tobago
rows.hook: is known for witty, topical lyrics and steel drum rhythms, and it is tied to Carnival

rows.label: doo-wop
rows.description: style of rhythm & blues
rows.hook: is known for street-corner vocal harmony groups singing nonsense syllables behind a lead singer

rows.label: gospel music
rows.description: genre of music emphasizing Christian lyrics
rows.hook: is sung in churches, with choirs and soaring praise-filled vocals

rows.label: bebop
rows.description: a style of jazz developed in the early to mid-1940s in the United States
rows.hook: is a fast, complex jazz style played by Charlie Parker and Dizzy Gillespie

rows.label: ragtime
rows.description: music genre
rows.hook: is a syncopated piano style made famous by Scott Joplin and The Entertainer

rows.label: dubstep
rows.description: genre of electronic dance music that originated in South London
rows.hook: is known for wobbling bass drops and a heavy sub-bass sound that shakes club speakers

rows.label: gamelan
rows.description: style of traditional music originated in the island of Java in Indonesia
rows.hook: is an orchestra of bronze gongs, metallophones and drums

rows.label: dancehall
rows.description: genre of Jamaican popular music
rows.hook: is a bass-heavy, DJ-driven cousin of reggae with fast digital riddims and chatting vocals

rows.label: mariachi
rows.description: form of traditional music from Mexico
rows.hook: is played by street bands in big sombreros with trumpets, violins and guitars

rows.label: J-pop
rows.description: Japanese popular music genre
rows.hook: is a bright, catchy sound tied to idol groups and anime theme songs
